entry: experiment_priorities.md item E145 (proposed and moved by viki 2026-11-26 20:05)

A1.label: E136's A1 (done): S against half a, read on T against half b

X.label: the exchange: T against half b, read on S against half a

F.label: the other flies: S against half b, read on T against half a

W.label: the other wirings: T against half a, read on S against half b

halves.a: E136's fit half: the first part of hal's split_halves(n, 1, seed 0) of each stage's flies

fit.start: the family's held megamat points of the cell's searched wirings (E134's step 3), every factor 1

reads.rule: megamat on the four read wirings against the read half; validation2, the mixtures and the APL16 input with APL on and off on all eight wirings; at the classed point, both rates held at each panel's operating point (E136's read_at)

yardsticks.bar: twice the standard error of a change over the cell's four read wirings
yardsticks.spreads: the family's over its eight wirings, as E136 scored them

inhadd.rule: pn_inhadd at the classed point between 562 and 1,778, nearer 1000 than E139's rungs at 314 and 3141

aplpn.rule: the APL->bouton factor determined (its single-factor return raises the loss by 0.010 or more) and between x0.078 and x0.31

kckc.rule: the KC-KC factor determined and at x1.8 or more (the lower end of E141's range)

classes.per_cell: E136's classes with E139's price, per cell, against the unrefitted family where the cell is read (its read wirings against its read half); A1's row beside as scored.
classes.fall_repeats: in all three cells the megamat stage error falls from the family's by more than the bar and by more than 0.040 (the control fit's fall).
classes.megamat_fixes_a_factor: the factor repeats (REPEAT) in all three cells.
classes.hold_repeats: "holds" as scored in cell X and in at least one of F and W; each with its share over the resamples, a share under 0.8 named a near-tie.
classes.the_flies: cell F differs from A1 in its class or in whether KC-KC repeats, and cell W does not.
classes.the_wirings: cell W differs from A1 in its class or in whether KC-KC repeats, and cell F does not.
classes.no_class: for a cell whose fit ends at a bound or whose holds fail, or for a wiring outside a realism band; the number of cells is reported with any that holds.

outcomes.a: The fall, the hold and all three factors repeat (about 1 in 5): A1 has been found twice where nothing of it was chosen; to Tom and Yang as a model that can be built on, with E141's question of the dose.
outcomes.b: The fall and the two factors before the calyx repeat, and KC-KC does not in two or more cells, which then read "megamat only" (about 1 in 3): megamat fixes the normalization and APL->bouton and nothing after them.
outcomes.c: The hold repeats at other factors (about 1 in 5): a larger additive term, or KC-KC elsewhere in E141's range; the fitted model is a range.
outcomes.d: The cells disagree (about 1 in 4): "the flies'" or "the wirings'"; A1's hold stays a near-tie.
outcomes.e: The fall does not repeat in a cell (about 1 in 20): to Tom and Yang at once.
outcomes.f: A fit ends at a bound (about 1 in 10, beside the others): that cell has no class; a planner rules on the bound before any wider search.

prediction.source: the planner's chances (the entry's), written before any fit

judgments: A cell's fit is E136's `fit_arm` of A1 in its search mode inside E136's `cell` and `paths`, so that E136's code, not a copy, fits each cell; 'fit' and 'held' in its records are the cell's own halves.

A cell's first evaluation (the family at z = 0) is checked against the start values step 0 reads from E134's saved held megamat runs on the cell's searched wirings against its fit half, to START_TOL (E136's START_CHECK_TOL); E136's own cell is read the same way and must reproduce E136's START_CHECK, which checks the reading.

The 0 differing counts at z = 0 are E136's `identity` of A1 on the cell's searched wirings, run before the fit (identity_A1.json in the cell's folder): every run reproduces E134's saved counts and responses exactly.
A fitted point is the cell's classed point (E136's `determined`: 'classed_z', else the best point), as E136 reads its arms.
Reads are tagged '<cell>_A1_<panel>_<wiring>' and claimed in the cell's folder, so that no tag is shared between cells or with E136.
The repeat of the additive term reads pn_inhadd at the classed point (E136's `pn_norm_kws`); the entry's 562 and 1,778 are taken as written.
The entry says the gain on pn_inhsc is not read; E136's returns found it determined in A1 (rise 0.064), and it is reported beside, reading nothing.
